Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome to our lavender wedding — a lavender dream, in the place where it grows. Thank you for travelling to Provence to stand with us among the rows.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Lily & Ethan

● ● ●

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2020 — A Flower Market

We met among the stalls

Lily was buying lavender; Ethan was buying the wrong flowers, confidently. She corrected him. He bought the lavender. They have argued about flowers happily ever since.

2021–2024 — The Provence Habit

Weekends in purple

Every free weekend became Provence — markets, lavender rows, and long lunches that lasted until sunset. Lily plans; Ethan photographs. The habit never stopped.

June 2026 — In the Lavender

He asked among the rows

On a warm evening in this very field, as bees moved through the lavender, Ethan asked properly, ring in a pocket. Lily said yes, then made him ask again so the field could be in the photo.

4 July 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

Lavender light, soft music, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Lavender Fields Estate, Provence — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

Marseille Provence Airport (MRS) is the nearest airport. Allow about 1 hour by car to the estate in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — Provence guesthouses & innsIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Village guesthouses near the estate; allow a short drive to the venue.
Mid-range — Lavender Village HotelIndicative band: mid nightly rates. A fifteen-minute drive from the estate, with breakfast and a pool.
Premium — Lavender Fields Estate (venue stay)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — lavender at your door every morning.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly. If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.

● ● ●

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The lavender welcome is the most child-friendly part.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Parking is available at the estate car park. Arrive by 5:00 PM — the country lanes are narrow, so allow extra time and plan your return ride.

Soft formal, lavender tones. Avoid heels on estate paths; wedges or flats are safest. Bring a light layer — Provence evenings cool after sunset.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

July in Provence is warm and usually dry, but a short shower is possible — dinner is indoors if it rains. The ceremony is outdoors among the lavender rows, so flat shoes are essential.
